questions.stem: From a cumulative frequency graph of $80$ values, which cumulative frequencies would you use to find the lower quartile ($Q_1$) and upper quartile ($Q_3$)?
questions.explanation: $Q_1$ is at $\frac{n}{4} = \frac{80}{4} = 20$th value and $Q_3$ is at $\frac{3n}{4} = \frac{3 \times 80}{4} = 60$th value.
